shortDescription: A Citigroup Inc. trader said the won’s recent weakness may be short-lived as South Korea’s chip sector supports growth and the currency’s recovery against the dollar by year-end, according to Bloomberg.The trader said to buy the won near 1,400 per dollar.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Citi Trader Says Buy Won Near 1,400 Per Dollar
